text:
olivia_am: Aurora wants to move a pilot from CompetitorDelta -> Redwood. Key asks: fixed pricing for ~10M tokens/mo, HMAC header passthrough for legacy auth (X-AUR-HMAC), stream framing compatibility (Delta uses 2-byte len-prefix), exact JSON key ordering for a brittle parser, stop-token trimming semantics, completed security questionnaire, and per-request token logs for audit. Can we run a preflight and list blockers?

ben_sol: I can handle pricing + framing. Pricing: mid-tier covers 10M; propose a one-month promo credit (30%) to accelerate sign. Framing: competitor uses big-endian 2-byte length prefixes. Our SSE stream can be wrapped by a small adapter (frame_mode=delta_len2) to emit those frames server-side. Will bench for latency (estimate 5-15ms/chunk).

tara_eng: Header passthrough: we drop cookies and secrets by default. We support route param preserve_headers=[...]. If they want Authorization or cross-tenant tokens forwarded we need legal review. Ask Aurora for exact header list.

wei_sec: Security: Data residency ok via Dedicated or Private. Customer-managed KMS only on Private. Per-request logs are possible under NDA, but raw-body retention needs CISO signoff. I'll start drafting questionnaire answers and flag the legal gates.

dom_cs: Pinged Aurora for sample request/response pairs and their filled questionnaire. Also asked them to confirm tokenization/bucket rounding (they currently bill in 6-token buckets) and to redact secrets. They want our answers by Fri COB. Link to uploads: https://redwood.app/drive/aurora/presales

ben_sol: JSON parity notes: main deltas are ordering of keys and stop-sequence trimming. Delta strips stop token and orders keys alphabetically which their parser expects. Options: (1) server-side compat flags stop_strip=true and canonicalize_json=alpha, (2) a small compatibility proxy on the client. For POC I'll add route-level flags. Tara, can we do that quickly?

tara_eng: Yes, will add route options {frame_mode:"delta_len2", preserve_headers:["x-aur-hmac"], stop_strip:true, canonicalize_json:"alpha"}. Quick nginx-ish snippet I will test: ```nginx
# ingress translator
proxy_set_header X-Preserve "x-aur-hmac,x-request-id";
``` Will run e2e in staging.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging namespace rwd-aurora-poc is provisioned on rwd-canary-3. Ephemeral creds expire in 48h. Recommend tests: 1) len2-framed stream smoke (15 prompts), 2) stop_strip + canonicalize_json parity (30 prompts), 3) header passthrough verification. Logs to /var/presales/aurora for 48h. :rocket:

wei_sec: I'll draft questionnaire answers focusing on network, auth, KMS. Marking raw-body retention and Authorization passthrough as CISO/legal items. dom_cs: can you upload their tokenization settings when they send them?

dom_cs: Uploaded their questionnaire and sample payloads (redacted). They confirmed X-AUR-HMAC and X-AUR-USER are required. They accept the 30% promo and asked for an invoice example with per-route line items and rounding explanation.

ben_sol: I'll prepare a sample invoice template showing 6-token rounding and per-route breakdown once staging smoke is green. Tara, please post latency numbers and logs. ETA for smoke: tomorrow morning.

tara_eng: Will push branch today and run smoke tests. If green, we can ship the POC SOW.

olivia_am: Great, thanks team. I'll hold off on SOW until we get green smoke and the sample invoice. Reminder: Aurora needs questionnaire answers by Fri COB. :thumbsup:
